name: [UPD] ⭐ Create A Car
desc:
🏁 Welcome to Create a Car! 🏁

Build a car that can drive, fly & glide through the map! 🌍
Dodge dangerous obstacles and show off your creation's ability 💥

Purchase vehicle parts like wheels, engine and gas! 🔧
Earn money and upgrade to be faster and go further! 💰
Collect coins and rare items while riding that can be sold for money! 🗝️
Create your dream ride! 🔨

⏰ Your car drives while offline 24/7! 😴

👍 Want to improve the game? Give it a like and leave feedback in the group page

☄️
